dedupe_keys.name: new caledonia active cadastral parcels parcelles cadastrales nc

description: Gouvernement de la Nouvelle-Calédonie publishes the reference data of every active cadastral parcel of New Caledonia: the cadastral identifier (NIC), lot number, subdivision, cadastral section, commune, cadastral area and typology, with the parcel geometry. Coverage: New Caledonia (a French special territory in the Pacific); about 77,000 parcels, updated frequently, with the record last modified on 2026-09-28. Format and access: CSV, JSON, GeoJSON, downloadable without registration from the open data portal of New Caledonia (data.gouv.nc). Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Licence Ouverte v2.0; cost: free. Caveats: records whose NIC begins with "0000-" are areas not yet inventoried, with no owner and geometry that just follows neighbouring parcels, and must not be treated as regular parcels; the parcel layer holds no building attributes. Simulation uses: parcel geometry for exposure, land-use and property-based risk models and for joining buildings and networks to land parcels. Related catalogue records: New Caledonia mining cadastre (Cadastre minier DIMENC, public views) (data-new-caledonia-dimenc-mining-cadastre).
name: New Caledonia: active cadastral parcels (Parcelles cadastrales NC)
